# upwind_threat_skills (Data Source)

Reads the metadata of every published Upwind threat Agent Skill.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All published threat agent skills.
data "upwind_threat_skills" "all" {}

output "available_skills" {
  value = [for s in data.upwind_threat_skills.all.skills : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `skills` (Attributes List) All published threat Agent Skills. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))

<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What this skill does and when an agent should use it. Agents match against this text when deciding whether the skill is relevant.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for this skill, e.g. `threat-policy-manager`. Also the path segment used to download it.
- `version` (String) The skill's published version.
